SELECT d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_year, min(d.calendar_date) mn, max(d.calendar_date) mx, count(*) n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=f2.sale_date WHERE d2.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d2.fiscal_period>=7 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=f2.sale_date WHERE d2.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d2.fiscal_period>=7 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_ids
FROM dim_date d WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period>=7 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date, s.store_id, p.category AS cat_was, cp.category AS cat_now, p.subcategory sub_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales, (w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS nomatch, w.status
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.category, cp.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net, false, 'ret'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN cat_was='Garden' THEN net_sales END) garden_was,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cat_now='Garden' THEN net_sales END) garden_now,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cat_was='Garden' AND store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) web_part,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cat_was='Garden' AND store_id=900 AND nomatch THEN net_sales END) web_nomatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cat_was='Garden' AND sub_was='Outdoor Lighting' THEN net_sales END) outdoor_light,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cat_was IS NULL THEN 1 END) nullcat
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'sales dup receipt/line' k, count(*) v FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales dup id', count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'return dup id', count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'return dup sales_line+date+qty', count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'return orphan', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web line no order', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web line store900 w/o dispatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales lines unmatched store key', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales lines unmatched product key', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product s ON s.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.product_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns unmatched product', count(*) FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product s ON s.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.product_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'product key dup', count(*) FROM (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store key dup', count(*) FROM (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'garden skus with outdoor lighting still Garden now', count(*) FROM dim_product WHERE is_current AND category='Garden' AND subcategory='Outdoor Lighting'

WITH dups AS (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING (receipt_id,line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (SELECT receipt_id,line_no, count(*) c, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(distinct etl_loaded_at) loads, count(distinct net_amount) amts, count(distinct product_key) pk FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT min(mn), max(mx), count(*), sum(c), max(c), min(loads), max(loads), max(amts), max(pk) FROM dups
